| `Example-PAG`、`Example-GIF`、`Example-Rive` 三个 iOS 示例在 `Example-Android` 中各有一个 Android 版本：`example-pag`、`example-gif`、`example-rive`（Gradle application 模块，Kotlin）。它们使用 Android 库 `cyltabbar`，Tab、PlusButton、页面与 iOS 示例相同，资源优先直接取自 iOS 示例：图片、颜色、字体与动画文件都读取 iOS 示例自己的文件（`Assets.xcassets`、字体目录、动画目录、库的资源 bundle），不复制；`demokit` 的 `DemoAssets` 按 Xcode 的方式读取资源目录（@2x / @3x 按屏幕密度选择、深色外观、PDF 由 `PdfRenderer` 渲染、颜色集）。三个 App 与 `app` 共用 `demokit` 模块：iOS `CYLSettingsDemoTableViewController` 对应的设置列表、PlusButton 角标演示（iOS `Example-Shared`）、样式切换。 | Each of the three iOS examples `Example-PAG`, `Example-GIF` and `Example-Rive` has an Android version in `Example-Android`: `example-pag`, `example-gif`, `example-rive` (Gradle application modules, Kotlin). They use the Android library `cyltabbar`, with the iOS examples' tabs, plus buttons and pages, and take their resources from the iOS examples first: images, colors, fonts and animation files are the iOS examples' own files (`Assets.xcassets`, the font folder, the animation folders, the library's resource bundle), not copies; `DemoAssets` in `demokit` reads an asset catalog the way Xcode does (@2x / @3x by screen density, the dark appearance, PDFs rendered with `PdfRenderer`, color sets). The three apps share the `demokit` module with `app`: the settings list of iOS `CYLSettingsDemoTableViewController`, the plus button badge demo (iOS `Example-Shared`), the style switch. |
| ObjC Example 的图片例外：`app` 与 `demokit` 不读取 `Example/Images.xcassets`（21 MB，其中 `AppIcon.appiconset` 不能作为资源打包），因此把用到的图片复制了一份：`demokit/src/main/assets/objc-example/TabBarIcon` 中的 Tab 图片（`home`、`message`、`fishpond`、`account` 的普通与选中图片）、PlusButton 的 `post_normal` / `post_highlight` 与 `videoback`；角标示例行的图标是库资源 bundle 中的 `cyl_badge_sample_icon`（即 App 图标），复制为 `cyltabbar` 的 `res/drawable-nodpi/cyl_badge_sample_icon.png`，由 `cyl_badgeIcon` 以 6 dp 圆角显示，与 iOS 相同。`DemoAssets` 找不到图片时记录 `CYLDemoAssets` 日志。 | An exception for the ObjC Example's images: `app` and `demokit` do not read `Example/Images.xcassets` (21 MB, and its `AppIcon.appiconset` cannot be packaged as assets), so the images they use are copied: the tab images in `demokit/src/main/assets/objc-example/TabBarIcon` (`home`, `message`, `fishpond`, `account`, normal and selected), the plus button's `post_normal` / `post_highlight`, and `videoback`; the badge rows' icon is the library bundle's `cyl_badge_sample_icon` (the app icon), copied to `cyltabbar`'s `res/drawable-nodpi/cyl_badge_sample_icon.png` and shown by `cyl_badgeIcon` with 6 dp corners, as on iOS. `DemoAssets` logs a missing image under `CYLDemoAssets`. |

## [CN]模块
## [EN]Modules

| 模块 Module | 内容 | Contents |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `example-gif` | 对应 `Example-GIF`；不需要第三方库（GIF 由系统解码）；GIF 文件来自 `Example-GIF/GIFApp/Resources` | `Example-GIF`; no third-party library (the platform decodes GIF); the GIF files come from `Example-GIF/GIFApp/Resources` |
| `example-pag` | 对应 `Example-PAG`；依赖 libpag（`com.tencent.tav:libpag`）；PAG 文件来自 `Example-Shared/PAGResources/tab-icons`，首次构建前由 `scripts/fetch-animation-resources.py` 下载（与 iOS 的 `pod install` 相同） | `Example-PAG`; depends on libpag (`com.tencent.tav:libpag`); the PAG files come from `Example-Shared/PAGResources/tab-icons`, downloaded before the first build by `scripts/fetch-animation-resources.py` (as `pod install` does on iOS) |
| `example-rive` | 对应 `Example-Rive`；依赖 rive-android（`app.rive:rive-android` 10.3.0）；`.riv` 文件来自 `Example-SwiftUI-Rive/AnimatedApp/RiveAssets` | `Example-Rive`; depends on rive-android (`app.rive:rive-android` 10.3.0); the `.riv` files come from `Example-SwiftUI-Rive/AnimatedApp/RiveAssets` |
| `demokit` | 共享的演示代码（Android library）：`DemoAssets`（读取 iOS 资源目录）、演示列表与设置行（`DemoCatalog.SETTINGS`）、`DemoTabBarActivity`、`DemoTabBarStyle`、`DemoPlusButtonBadge`、`DemoPublishPlusButton`、展示页与配置用例 | The shared demo code (an Android library): `DemoAssets` (reads the iOS asset catalogs), the demo lists and the settings rows (`DemoCatalog.SETTINGS`), `DemoTabBarActivity`, `DemoTabBarStyle`, `DemoPlusButtonBadge`, `DemoPublishPlusButton`, the gallery and the configuration cases |

## [CN]示例对照
## [EN]The examples side by side

| 示例 Example | iOS 功能 | Android 实现 | Status | iOS feature | Android implementation |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| GIF | 第 1 个 Tab：GIF key（`CYLTabBarGIFFilePath`），选中时播放一次 | 相同的 key，`tab_rocket.gif` | done | Tab 1: a GIF key (`CYLTabBarGIFFilePath`), plays once when selected | The same key, `tab_rocket.gif` |
| GIF | 第 2 个 Tab：通用 key（`CYLTabBarAnimationFilePath`） | 相同的 key，`tab_star.gif` | done | Tab 2: the generic key (`CYLTabBarAnimationFilePath`) | The same key, `tab_star.gif` |
| GIF | 第 3 个 Tab：作为图片传入的 GIF（`CYLTabBarItemImageURL`）循环播放 | 库新增 `CYLGIFDrawable`：作为图片传入的 GIF 循环播放（对应 `+cyl_animatedImageWithGIFData:`） | done | Tab 3: a GIF given as an image (`CYLTabBarItemImageURL`) loops | New in the library: `CYLGIFDrawable`, a GIF given as an image loops (the twin of `+cyl_animatedImageWithGIFData:`) |
| GIF | 首页为设置列表；没有子页面的 "发布" PlusButton；1.5 倍速；橙色强调色 | `DemoCatalog.SETTINGS`、`DemoPublishPlusButton`、`tabBarItemAnimationSpeed`、`setTintColor` | done | Home is the settings list; a "Publish" plus button without a page; 1.5x speed; orange tint | `DemoCatalog.SETTINGS`, `DemoPublishPlusButton`, `tabBarItemAnimationSpeed`, `setTintColor` |
| PAG | 四个 PAG Tab 图标（33 pt，1.5 倍速），文件不存在时显示图片 | 相同的文件与 key；文件不存在时不加 key 并输出提示 | done | Four PAG tab icons (33 pt, 1.5x), the image when a file is missing | The same files and keys; without a file, no key and a log hint |
| PAG | PlusButton：标题 "菜单" 画在 tabbar_database 背景图上，第 3 项，页面为 "菜单" | `MenuPlusButton` | done | Plus button: the title "Menu" on the tabbar_database background, the third item, its page "Menu" | `MenuPlusButton` |
| PAG | 首页：角标帮助列表、"全屏" 按钮上抖动的随机颜色红点，push 子页面（"next" 按钮）、下一页，点击重新创建 TabBar；3A57ED 导航栏、白色标题；push 的页面隐藏 TabBar | `HomePage`、`ChildPage`、`NextPage`、`NavigationPage`（ActionBar 标题、返回按钮、`setTabBarHidden`） | done | Home: the badge helper table, a shaking dot of a random color on the "Full screen" item, pushes a child page ("next" item) and a next page, taps create the tab bar again; the 3A57ED navigation bar with white titles; pushed pages hide the tab bar | `HomePage`, `ChildPage`, `NextPage`, `NavigationPage` (action bar title, back button, `setTabBarHidden`) |
| PAG | 首次启动的引导页（3 张图、5 秒跳过） | `GuideActivity` | done | The guide on first launch (3 images, a 5 s skip) | `GuideActivity` |
| PAG | 西柚皮肤原地互换两个 Tab 的动画（#216）；"我的" 为设置列表 | `CYLThemeManager` 监听 + `updateTabBarItemAtIndex`；`DemoCatalog.SETTINGS` | done | The Grapefruit skin swaps two tabs' animations in place (#216); "Me" is the settings list | A `CYLThemeManager` listener + `updateTabBarItemAtIndex`; `DemoCatalog.SETTINGS` |
| Rive | Tab 图标为 icons.riv 的画板（状态机 + "active" 输入，`CYLTabBarRiveURL`） | `CourseTab.animationAttributes`，同样的选项 | done | Tab icons are icons.riv artboards (state machine + "active" input, `CYLTabBarRiveURL`) | `CourseTab.animationAttributes`, the same options |
| Rive | "Start" PlusButton，标题与 Tab 标题对齐（#636），页面为课程引导页 | `StartPlusButton`（`alignsTitleWithTabBarItemTitles`）、`OnboardingPage`（shapes.riv、button.riv） | done | The "Start" plus button, its title aligned with the tab titles (#636), its page the course onboarding | `StartPlusButton` (`alignsTitleWithTabBarItemTitles`), `OnboardingPage` (shapes.riv, button.riv) |
| Rive | Chat：`HomeView`（VCard、HCard）；Search：`SideMenu`，图标为 icons.riv 画板，选中项为蓝色背景，"Dark Mode" 开关播放 / 停止图标 | `CoursesPage`、`SideMenuPage`：逐项翻译 SwiftUI 视图，使用课程自己的字体（Poppins、Inter）、图片（主题、头像、Spline、图标、标志）与颜色 | done | Chat: `HomeView` (VCard, HCard); Search: `SideMenu`, icons from icons.riv, the selected item on blue, the "Dark Mode" switch plays / stops its icon | `CoursesPage`, `SideMenuPage`: the SwiftUI views translated item by item, with the course's own fonts (Poppins, Inter), images (topics, avatars, Spline, icons, logos) and colors |
| Rive | Bell：设置列表上方的 menu_button.riv 与 "播放 / 停止" | `BellPage` | done | Bell: menu_button.riv with "Play / Stop" above the settings list | `BellPage` |
| Rive | User：登录，check.riv（Check / Error 触发）与 confetti.riv | `SignInPage` | done | User: sign in, check.riv (Check / Error triggers) and confetti.riv | `SignInPage` |
| Rive | 深色 TabBar、白色强调色；西柚皮肤互换 Chat 与 User 的图标 | TabBar 颜色；`CYLThemeManager` 监听 | done | A dark tab bar with white tints; the Grapefruit skin swaps the icons of Chat and User | Bar colors; a `CYLThemeManager` listener |
| 全部 / All | PlusButton 角标（启动后为 1，每次点击加 1）、弹性点击动画、长按、滑动切换；导航栏的样式切换 | `DemoPlusButtonBadge`、`DemoTabBarStyle`（ActionBar 按钮） | done | The plus button badge (1 after launch, +1 per tap), bounce taps, long press, swipe; the style switch in the navigation bar | `DemoPlusButtonBadge`, `DemoTabBarStyle` (an action bar button) |

## [CN]运行与验证
## [EN]Running and checking

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 构建需要 UTF-8 区域设置（macOS 与常见桌面系统的默认值）：Example-PAG 的资源目录中有中文名称的图片集（`屏幕全屏`），在 POSIX 区域设置下 Gradle 无法读取该文件名；CI 中请设置 `LC_ALL=C.UTF-8`。 | Building needs a UTF-8 locale (the default on macOS and common desktop systems): Example-PAG's asset catalog has an image set with a Chinese name (`屏幕全屏`), which Gradle cannot read under a POSIX locale; set `LC_ALL=C.UTF-8` on CI. |
| 在 Android Studio 中打开 `Example-Android`，运行 `example-gif`、`example-pag` 或 `example-rive`。`example-pag` 首次构建时下载 PAG 文件（需要 python3 与网络）；没有时构建继续，Tab 显示图片，也可以手动执行 `python3 scripts/fetch-animation-resources.py PAGResources`。 | Open `Example-Android` in Android Studio and run `example-gif`, `example-pag` or `example-rive`. `example-pag` downloads the PAG files on its first build (python3 and the network); without them the build goes on and the tabs show their images, or run `python3 scripts/fetch-animation-resources.py PAGResources` yourself. |
| `gradle :example-gif:testDebugUnitTest :example-pag:testDebugUnitTest :example-rive:testDebugUnitTest`（Robolectric）检查 Tab、key、PlusButton、页面、引导页、皮肤互换与 PlusButton 角标；三个模块与 `demokit` 的 lint 没有问题。 | `gradle :example-gif:testDebugUnitTest :example-pag:testDebugUnitTest :example-rive:testDebugUnitTest` (Robolectric) checks the tabs, keys, plus buttons, pages, the guide, the skin swaps and the plus button badge; lint reports no issues in the three modules and `demokit`. |

## [CN]差异与限制
## [EN]Differences and limits

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 库通过反射调用 libpag 与 rive-android，方法名与参数按两个库的真实类核对（`PAGView`、`RiveAnimationView`），并由测试检查；rive-android 的 Kotlin 默认参数通过其 `$default` 方法传递（如 `Fit.CONTAIN`、`Loop.AUTO`），按官方示例在加载时传入画板与状态机。 | The library calls libpag and rive-android by reflection; the method names and parameters were checked against both libraries' real classes (`PAGView`, `RiveAnimationView`) and a test checks them; rive-android's Kotlin default parameters go through its `$default` methods (e.g. `Fit.CONTAIN`, `Loop.AUTO`), and the artboard and state machine are given at load, as the official sample does. |
| libpag 与 rive-android 带原生代码，JVM 上无法加载：测试只检查 key、页面与回退，未在设备或模拟器上运行；GIF 循环在 JVM 上无法解码（`Movie`），该测试只在能解码的环境中运行。 | libpag and rive-android load native code, which the JVM cannot: the tests check the keys, pages and fallbacks, and nothing was run on a device or an emulator; `Movie` decodes no GIF on the JVM, so the looping test runs only where it can. |
| rive-android 固定为 10.3.0：更新的版本需要 compileSdk 36（androidx.core 1.17）或 Compose。lifecycle 2.9 的 lint 检查（`NullSafeMutableLiveData`）会让本项目的 lint 崩溃，`example-rive` 中关闭了该检查（App 不使用 LiveData）。 | rive-android is pinned to 10.3.0: newer versions need compileSdk 36 (androidx.core 1.17) or Compose. The lint check of lifecycle 2.9 (`NullSafeMutableLiveData`) crashes this project's lint, so `example-rive` turns it off (the app has no LiveData). |
| 示例按 iOS 源码直接翻译（文字、字体、尺寸、颜色、时序），遇到问题时参考官方示例（[pag-android](https://github.com/libpag/pag-android)、[pag-enterprise-android](https://github.com/libpag/pag-enterprise-android)、[rive-android](https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android)）。SwiftUI 的 `blur` 只在 Android 12 及以后生效（RenderEffect），`.regularMaterial` 以半透明白色表示。iOS 示例的 Liquid Glass 效果在 Android 上不存在，样式切换只改变 `tabBarStyleType`。 | The examples are translated directly from the iOS sources (texts, fonts, sizes, colors, timing), with the official samples ([pag-android](https://github.com/libpag/pag-android), [pag-enterprise-android](https://github.com/libpag/pag-enterprise-android), [rive-android](https://github.com/rive-app/rive-android)) as the reference when a question comes up. SwiftUI's `blur` applies on Android 12 and later only (RenderEffect), and `.regularMaterial` is a translucent white. The iOS examples' Liquid Glass does not exist on Android; the style switch only changes `tabBarStyleType`. |
